initial_sql: WITH user_stats AS (SELECT u.id, u.username, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id), platform_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM user_stats) SELECT us.username, ROUND(us.total_spent, 2) AS total_spent, us.order_count, us.product_count FROM user_stats us, platform_avg pa WHERE us.total_spent > pa.avg_spent * 2 AND us.order_count > 8 ORDER BY us.total_spent DESC
